name: track_commit_timestamp
description: Enables collection and storage of the commit timestamp for each transaction.
symptoms: Inability to perform logical replication with time-based filtering
Missing commit time metadata for conflict resolution in multi-master setups
Failure to use pg_xact_commit_timestamp() or pg_last_committed_xact() functions
tuning_tips: Enable only when required for logical replication, conflict detection, or auditing; requires a server restart and increases WAL size slightly.
